verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own app docs state that it lets users manage local models, prompts, and configurations, which matches the story directly. Supporting docs show in-app model search and download, plus per-load settings such as GPU offload and context length via `lms load`. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of saved-prompt management and persistent per-model configuration presets, explicit evidence that all three live in one unified view, independent hands-on corroboration of the management workflow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage my downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations in one place

citations.quote: Manage your local models, prompts, and configurations
